contentText: US President Donald Trump gave a speech at the Davos forum in which he based his desire to take over Greenland that it had been once owned by the US, and was "given" to Denmark after World War Two. But as FRANCE 24's Douglas Herbert reminds us, that is historically false. Trump also implied once again the false equivalency between Ukraine and Russia, "ignoring that Russia is the aggressor that invaded Ukraine".
